amends: native-protocol-r1.json startup platform and isolation only; full-population measurement remains future gated work

runner.trigger: push only on controller-created tools/azure-policy-probe-run, never merged or tag-triggered
runner.brownout_revisit: Before March/April 2027 or any label refusal, revisit T-R11 with controller
runner.successor: ubuntu-24.04 x64 (ubuntu-26.04 x64 also available), only after controller ruling and userns/mountns preflight

rules: Stage linux-x64 instead of the non-working local ARM route; ARM observations are explicitly unreceipted and grant no metric. Verify all 455 pinned payload files, copy them to worker scratch and reverify the copy before vendor execution.

Use kernel user/network/PID/mount namespaces with unshare --user --map-root-user --net --pid --fork --kill-child --mount --mount-proc; measure PID 1 and loopback-only interfaces. No unisolated fallback. Kill normal and timeout process groups; PID namespace exit kills detached descendants.

Before download, preflight imports, loopback and the same read-only mount/write controls used by the real worker. Report a fixed failed-stage enum (including mountns) and integer/null kernel capabilities; raw stderr and exceptions stay private.

Keep download cache, launcher logs and public receipt outside writable worker scratch. Bind only worker scratch, select reachable topmost mounts by mount/parent IDs and remount outside mounts read-only; no root-on-root bind or chroot. Ignore hidden mounts and hidden descendants. Drop vendor capabilities with setpriv and no_new_privs. Require EROFS for plain, /.. and /proc/.. spellings of checkout, runner HOME, RUNNER_TEMP, cache and running-launcher writes, plus a successful scratch write. Measured denials admit the readonly/dot-dot flags and count; no unisolated fallback.

Pin schema and identities before vendor execution, including the filesystem-helper hash. After PID namespace teardown, validate a bounded regular no-follow worker receipt and its exit/status agreement. Outer publication/log failures yield receipt_invalid and exit 2; use exclusive no-follow logs and fresh receipt temporary names. Parse the shell launcher body before execution. Only separately published schema-validated receipt.json may leave the runner.
Run three authored API variants independently after bounded readiness polling; completion requires clean shutdown. Startup is not a calibration metric or complete native population proof.

Runner explicitly selects at least 1 GiB free on cache/output filesystems, load at most 6, nice 10; lane defaults remain 20 GiB and load 6. No Docker, global install, Rosetta, paid call or Azure login.

The staged workflow remains calibration/oracles/azure-policy/probe-linux-x64.workflow.yml until the controller copies it to the fixed run branch. Pin Node 24 actions by full SHA. Revisit the T-R11 runner before its 2027-04-17 retirement and March/April brownouts; successor is ubuntu-24.04 x64 after a controller ruling and namespace preflight. L3 calibration is outside this startup probe; D19 is now on main.

Require the real Linux namespace regression on the runner, including hidden old-proc submounts and independent persistent dot-dot write attempts. Off Linux exactly the two designated Linux tests may skip; local mocked results grant no Linux proof. Failed required controls permit preflight diagnostics/refusal only, not preparation or vendor execution.

T-R13a: one rerun, vendor child soft/hard FSIZE 256 MiB; launcher/worker native-execution soft FSIZE 8 MiB with finite inherited 256 MiB ceiling; stderr/LSP/outer trace captures 8 MiB, receipt reads and writes 128 KiB. Preparation keeps its existing pinned archive/member bounds. No unlimited or untraced fallback.

Keep strace outside the vendor nested PID/mount/proc namespace. Close inherited trace writers before entering it; authored PID1 waits for ordinary-signal vendor PID2 under zero capabilities. Preserve scratch as the sole writable filesystem subtree and all existing isolation controls.

Require the production-chain authored Linux SIGXFSZ regression before preparation or vendor execution. Off Linux exactly the filesystem and tracing kernel tests may skip. Missing preinstalled strace or failed required control stops vendor execution. Parser-integrity or capture failure refuses diagnostics; any already validated worker outcome is retained.

After namespace teardown, record bounded scratch-relative HOME/TMP paths, final sizes, largest final file, successful write-family bytes and requested extents. T-R13a permits those relative paths in receipt.json only; no contents, absolute paths or raw trace may leave the runner. No target path is hashed. Other targets collapse to fixed classes with no name. Do not publish a raw-trace hash or raw-trace byte count, both of which depend on private roots. Cap public rows at 64; redact unsafe names and relative-cwd targets; report row/snapshot overflow explicitly as partial, retaining the largest inspected file. A parser refusal never erases validated worker fields; a parsed trace lacking vendor exec or exit instead yields contradicted, probe_refused at tracing, native_executed null (unknown) and native_returncode null, preserving initialize/stderr/LSP evidence. Correlate EFBIG and SIGXFSZ per thread; never guess the first untraced cause.
N3-m1: refuse any mount stacked on namespace root before remounting; keep the real runner fixture unchanged.

T-R14: decoded dot or empty components within HOME/TMP retain private raw-key rows with null public names; any dot-dot uses other regardless of lexical normalization or symlinks. Recheck2 n4: every other target, including noncanonical spellings and all dot-dot paths, collapses by fixed kind; raw keys are HOME/TMP-only. Recheck2 n5 corrects contradiction to unknown/null, never false. Select snapshot names lexically before the 4096 inspected-entry cap with at most 4097 retained entries; directory-name enumeration is bounded by the workflow ten-minute job timeout. Require exact/cap+1 snapshot controls, reversed-readdir equivalence, trace target 64+1 partial-publication proof, and snapshot-cap/contradiction mutants.

T-R15/T-R16: a pre-vendor authored-control refusal does not spend the admitted rerun. mount_readonly changes cwd to scratch, so explicitly start the ordinary-signal child in private HOME. Preserve relative-open control and absolute fd decoding; no cwd guesses in diagnostics. Control assertion failures log only compared relative-path/count/flag fields, never receipt fields or raw traces. Require both controller-run Ubuntu22 authored commands to pass at the candidate sha before READY or another vendor attempt.
artifact: receipt.json only; counts, hashes, fixed enums/flags and T-R13a allowlisted scratch-relative HOME/TMP filenames; never contents, absolute paths, raw trace, LSP, evaluations or stderr
review_amendment: T-R13/T-R13a plus binding B1/m1/m2: no path hashes or raw-trace identity; root-independent HOME/TMP relative records, 64-row coherent receipt budget, explicit partial/refused diagnostics preserve validated worker outcome. N3-m1 retained; no native API success or calibration claim. T-R14 n1/n2/n3: noncanonical raw-key redaction, explicit parsed contradiction withdrawing execution, deterministic bounded snapshot selection and cap+1/mutation controls. T-R16 corrects private child cwd after mount setup; diagnostic-only Linux confirmation required before READY.
